extraction.design_notes: Single-center, randomized, open-label, cross-over phase-2 trial. Participants received pioglitazone and liraglutide treatments in two 16-week periods, in random order, with an 8-week washout period between the two treatments. Primary and secondary endpoint analyses were performed on the per protocol set of patients with measurements available at pre-treatment and week-16 for treatment arms.

key_inclusion_criteria: adulthood, a diagnosis of T2D at least 6 months before enrolment and a glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) level of no more than 86mmol/mol at the screening (baseline) visit
Participants were either drug-naïve or on treatment with oral glucose-lowering therapies for at least 12-weeks prior to screening
